text:
carmen (design): quick convo  compact spend rows feel dense. proposal: a tiny "Preview" affordance in the token cell that reveals a 3-line mini-ledger on hover or via keyboard. works for org & project scope.
leo (frontend): sounds good. perf note: with ~250 rows we must not hydrate heavy SVGs. plan: render a lightweight placeholder, lazy-hydrate canvas/sparkline on interaction after 120ms. cancel if mouse leaves.
maya (pm): i'd like to AB test hover+focus preview vs explicit Preview button to see accidental opens. metrics: preview_opened, method, preview_to_invoice_click, backend_preview_qps.
igor (infra): backend guardrails: per-user LRU cache (TTL=4m), debounce client fetch 200ms, server-side rate-limit and batch endpoint for multiple rows. avoid one-request-per-hover spikes.
sam (a11y): accessibility checklist: preview must be reachable by keyboard. include a small <button class="preview-toggle"> with aria-controls pointing to preview region id and aria-expanded toggled. preview region should have role="region" and aria-live="polite" and include a visually-hidden summary with id=preview-summary-{rowId}.
carmen (design): copy: preview header = "Token breakdown  last 30 days". button label = "Preview". inline preview should not contain full invoice download link; that belongs in persistent drawer only.
leo (frontend): keyboard flow: Tab -> Preview button -> Enter opens inline panel -> Esc closes and returns focus to button. If user opens drawer, trap focus. honor prefers-reduced-motion.
maya (pm): action items: carmen update figma frames + microcopy, leo implement feature flag + preview-shell + lazy load, igor add cache+throttle, sam write a11y test checklist. will roll out small percent and monitor qps.
bot-deploy: :white_check_mark: staging smoke passed 2026-03-25T14:30Z
carmen (design): thanks all  i'll post updated frames and the experiment ticket later today :sparkles:
